fallback_reason: Task tool not available in this environment — only ToolSearch / TaskStop are exposed. Reviewed by re-reading the diff and the new module/tests against the 11 review dimensions.
summary: Clean stdlib-only CLI. argparse subparser dispatch, each cmd_* returns an int exit code, main() pushes it through sys.exit. Inputs validated at the boundary via _validate_stage_payload; failure mode is a ValueError caught once in cmd_stage. Path-guard on preview fires before any webbrowser.open. Preview-html-path column + helper added to repo as scoped by Task 1 deviation note.

findings.finding: skip prompt used _err() which always appends a newline — so the operator sees the question on one line and their answer prompt on a different line. Minor UX nit.
findings.recommendation: Write the prompt with sys.stderr.write + flush, no trailing newline.

findings.finding: CACHE_DIR is resolved at import time. If a future code-path needs to override it (e.g. integration tests), patching the module-level Path is required. Tests already use patch('hw_review.CACHE_DIR', ...) so the pattern works.

Validator raises ValueError with descriptive messages; single catch in cmd_stage rewraps them as 'staging rejected: {exc}'. Consistent with the 'rejection reason is the exception message' pattern used elsewhere in the repo.
_age_hours parses SQLite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as UTC timezone-aware. Guarded against malformed strings via try/except → returns 0.

action_taken: Applied fix for cr-1 (skip prompt uses sys.stderr.write + flush). Other findings are info-level with no action required.
